{{Top|leg}}
The '''Imperial Substance Control Authority''' was a branch of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] tasked with ensuring the safety of medicines and drugs throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Security officers from the Imperial Substance Control Authority were often stationed at [[Medcenter/Legends|hospitals]] to guard the supplies from theft.<ref name="Abduction">''[[The Abduction]]''</ref>
